name: Free Pre-Recruitment Training
benefit: Under this scheme, 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a son of an ex-serviceman. 1. The applicant's age should be more than 16 years and less than 21 years. 1. The applicant should have passed high school with 45% marks. ***All expenses incurred on training (honorarium of trainers + food + accommodation) are borne by the Directorate of Sainik Welfare.*** **Note: 5** courses are conducted each year.
